increment_paragraph: **RULE33-PILOT (pluggable-cards seam B, P2 pilot 4; halted, evidence in round 2).** The [card](../../reports/rule33-pilot/README.md) moves gateway rule 33 (the checked removed-selection frame) into its own package, `crates/gateway-rules/rule-33-removed-selection`, behind the gateway rule interface, and registers its run-time switch. The package holds the pure decisions (moved verbatim from the deleted `removed_selection.rs`), the frame bodies' word shapes, the caller expansion and the frame row's admission; `legacy_selection.rs` stays the host, reading each frame against the contract environment, type model and linkage, building the selection entry and observing the run. Two additive, vocabulary-free capabilities are added to `qcore-gateway-rule-api` (`statement_expansion.rs`): `StatementExpansion`, which answers a whole rewritten body with each word anchored to the input word whose line it takes, and `EntryRow`. Registry row `33` has two arms placed by effect, `statement-rewrite`/`removed-selection-expansion` and `classification`/`removed-selection-entry`, since no route-map position names CFG-build body rewrites or derivation rows (GATEWAY-RULE-API-BODY-REWRITE-POSITION). `QCORE_GATEWAY_RULES_OFF=33` expands nothing and installs no frame, which is the gateway before rule 33: the retained cJSON frames and a decimal-constant caller keep their pre-rule-33 refusals (`tests/rule33_switch.rs`); rule 33 is a pure admission, so no guard stays unswitchable. Lean `QCore.RemovedSelectionSwitch` (10 audited theorems): on is the rule, off installs no frame and expands nothing, off never widens a frame row or a caller. The card was halted while measuring and merged as found (`16df251ad`); round 2's shared measurement (RULE36-PILOT, BASE `0d15e7b19` -> TIP `62c8e461c`, `--rules-off 33,34,36 --per-rule`, status complete) matched the declared `none` on all three routes with 0 moved and 0 content-changed rows (its corpus composition-conflict classification is RULE36-PILOT's to report). Contribution by switch (`contract/contributions/33/`, consistent): eight-home 2 rows Unknown -> Safe, `cJSON_DetachItemFromArray` and `cJSON_DeleteItemFromArray` under `detach_list_representation`, exactly rule 33's recorded delta; system and slice none; no interaction. The per-rule group is committed whole (rules 33, 34, 36), written from `docs/reports/rule36-pilot/native-comparison.json`. Card gate before the halt (`dc72dee7e`): Rust 8,854 passed, 0 failed, 15 ignored; Lean 391 audits; Python 554 tests, 1 failure (the matrix's derived `lean_audits`, since regenerated); round-2 records-only gate on the final commit in the report. Parity cost for plan decision 6: about 700 lines of rule code moved into a 994-line package, 1,782 added and 712 deleted lines in all, 0.6 h from reading to the code commit, and one shared 12 h measurement for three rules.

ledger.title: No route-map position for CFG-build body rewrites or derivation row routes
ledger.text: ROUTE-MAP section 1 lists the per-CFG-build body rewrites (_Generic resolution, literal premises, 11r, and since rule 33 the removed-selection expansion) beside the token holds, and the custody derivation's function-row routes (rule 33's frame install and row under its selection entry, rule 37's checked-specification settlement) are not mapped at all. The only position of section 1 is token-hold, a hold, which forces not-switchable; so RULE33-PILOT registered its expansion arm at statement-rewrite and its entry-row arm at classification, by effect, as RULE37-PILOT did for its settlement arm. Placement by effect is unchecked: the generator and the route-map test cannot tell whether an arm sits where its host consults it. DISCHARGE: add non-hold positions for body rewrites and derivation rows to qcore-gateway-rule-api's Position and the route map, move the arms placed by effect there (an identity run per move), or record that placement by effect is the registry's policy.

RULE33-PILOT (halted 2026-10-29, evidence in round 2) migrated rule 33 to crates/gateway-rules/rule-33-removed-selection, adding two vocabulary-free capabilities (StatementExpansion with line anchors, EntryRow); its expansion and entry-row arms are placed by effect (GATEWAY-RULE-API-BODY-REWRITE-POSITION). Identity: the round-2 shared measurement (BASE 0d15e7b19 -> TIP 62c8e461c, all three halted moves) matched the declared none on all routes, 0 moved and 0 content-changed rows. Switch-measured ledgers contract/contributions/33/ (eight-home +2 Safe, the two cJSON array wrappers; system 0; slice 0; no interaction). Registry id 33 is known to known_rule. Remaining after 33: 34 and 36 (their round-2 cards) and 32a.

Compared with rule 33's recorded BASE -> TIP delta (975 -> 977 Safe, cJSON_DetachItemFromArray and cJSON_DeleteItemFromArray Unknown -> Safe): the switch moves exactly those two rows on eight-home and nothing on system or slice (docs/reports/rule33-pilot/README.md section 3).
